comments.author: @Paul-Richman
comments.text:
Why are people still doing business with the Big 3 Wireless companies? I worked in telecom for almost 20 years for AT&T, GTE, and Verizon, and I can tell you that the smaller telecom companies ride the same network as the larger ones. I currently pay $200 a YEAR (less than $17 a month) for Mint Mobile (recently acquired by T-Mobile). I get unlimited nationwide calling and 5GB of data per month,  and I barely use half that limit. 

I think many people get locked into these contracts because they want the latest $1500 iPhone or Samsung Galaxy. I moved to Bangkok last year, but I still kept my Mint Mobile plan because I can make and receive calls to and from the States for free using Wi-Fi calling. I also have a Thai phone plan that gives me unlimited data for around $13 USD per month. I have a Thai phone number and have to pay a little extra if I make voice calls, but most people here use Whatsapp to communicate, which uses data and not voice.  If you want to save money, purchase a new phone that's maybe two or three years old (on eBay or Amazon) and get a plan with a company like Mint Mobile.
